findings.title: Choice-format strip hides HTML from the sanitizer
findings.body: Before the OWASP policy runs, normalizeValue() deletes every `{n,choice,...}` subformat on `error-invalid-multivalued-size` and any key starting with `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit`, using `\{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*}` which consumes arbitrary text up to the closing brace, including tags. A translation such as `{0,choice,0#minutes|1#minute|1<reset}` is reduced to `...` and passes the checker. Those time-unit strings are MessageFormat-formatted and substituted unescaped into HTML email bodies (verification, password reset, execute-actions), so a translator can inject links or markup into official mail. The same hole exists for `error-invalid-multivalued-size`. Only the choice-format `<` limit marker should be neutralized (or the subformat text itself sanitized), and a test should cover a tag hidden inside a choice branch.

findings.title: Account UI validation message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: This account-ui bundle is loaded by i18next, which interpolates `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}`. Sibling keys in the same file still use that form (for example `error-invalid-length-too-short='{{0}}' must have minimal length of {{1}}.`). This change replaces `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` with Java MessageFormat `{0}` and a `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` plural, which i18next does not evaluate. Users who fail the multivalued-size check will see the literal string, including `{0}` and the choice pattern, with no attribute name or limits. Restore the `{{n}}` placeholders and a plain wording such as `value(s)`. The Java choice format is only valid in the server-side theme bundles.

findings.title: Admin UI validation message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: The keycloak.v2 admin console reads this file through i18next, which only substitutes `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}`. The previous value used those placeholders (`Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).`). It was rewritten to Java MessageFormat `{0}` plus `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`, which the React admin UI will not format. The multivalued-size validation error will display the raw pattern and empty placeholders instead of the attribute name and bounds. Keep the `{{n}}` form and `value(s)` here. The choice-format wording in `themes/.../theme/base/admin/messages/messages_en.properties` is the copy that MessageFormat actually evaluates.

findings.title: Illegal-HTML diff reporter can throw and abort the scan
findings.body: When the sanitized string differs from the original, the reporter computes a common prefix (`start`) and a common suffix (`end`) independently, then calls `substring(start, length - end)` on both strings without checking that `start + end` is within each length. If those regions overlap, `substring` throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. That is a realistic sanitizer result: `test<script>test` is reduced to `test`, `start` and `end` are both 4, and `sanitized.substring(4, 0)` throws. `verify()` only catches IOException, so the RuntimeException aborts the file, the Illegal HTML message is never returned, and later keys in that file are not checked. Clamp the range or fall back to the full strings before calling substring.

findings.title: Lithuanian account TOTP step replaced with Italian
findings.body: totpStep1 was changed from a Lithuanian sentence (with FreeOTP/Google Play links) to the Italian sentence `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` (`Install one of the following applications on your phone`). Lithuanian users on the account TOTP setup screen will be shown Italian instructions. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation of the current English source, for example `Įdiekite vieną iš šių programų savo mobiliajame telefone:`.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP step replaced with Italian
findings.body: loginTotpStep1, shown during the login-theme OTP required action, was replaced with the Italian sentence `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` instead of Lithuanian. Users configuring an authenticator in the lt locale will not get instructions in their language. Use a Lithuanian translation of `Install one of the following applications on your mobile:`, not the Italian string copied here.

findings.title: zh_CN TOTP step written in Traditional Chinese
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Simplified Chinese account bundle was set to Traditional Chinese: `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). zh_CN users will see Traditional characters. Neighboring strings in this file are Simplified, and the login zh_CN equivalent is already Simplified (`在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`). Use a Simplified translation such as `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.
